definitions: A rare brain malformation characterized by the absence of normal convolutions (gyri) and grooves (sulci) in the cerebral cortex, resulting in a smooth brain surface.
A neurological disorder caused by defective neuronal migration during fetal development.
examples: The child was diagnosed with lissencephaly.
Research into the genetic causes of lissencephaly is ongoing.
Lissencephaly can lead to severe developmental delays.
